correctness.rationale: Exact Beer substitution gives Δ=∫[q²s,qs]g−∫[qs,s]g with g=e^(−bt)−e^(−at)>0. The strict decrease of E(t)=t g′(t)/g(t) yields strict increase of the lower/upper ratio from q² to ∞, so there is exactly one global order switch for every a>b>0, 0<q<1. Taylor expansion at L=0 and dominated convergence at q=0 prove the two limiting laws. Independent rational evaluation gives −1/512 and 526/6561 for two sign witnesses; 7,839 standalone deterministic checks passed. Limits and full quantifiers are proved analytically; tests do not replace any infinite statement.

value.rationale: This is a motivated stratification choice for two real physiological types under a standard attenuating-light and photoinhibition model, not an arbitrary numerical parameter slice. The pointwise weaker response can become the unique superior upper placement at high incident light; the sign reverses exactly once for every contrast and thickness. The thin-layer logarithmic-elasticity frontier and thick-layer median frontier are structural, testable scaling laws. The 83.83% separation at a concrete dimensionless benchmark shows the possible size of the sorting effect, but no empirical gain or downstream theorem is claimed.
